Calculate Akaike's Information Criterion for a WHAM model

Source: R/aic.R
aic.Rd

Calculates AIC from a fitted WHAM model's negative log-likelihood and number of estimated parameters.

Usage

aic(mod, conditional = FALSE)

Arguments

mod

A fitted WHAM model object returned by fit_wham().

conditional

(TRUE/FALSE) When the model includes random effects, the default (conditional = FALSE) calculation uses the marginal likelihood and number of fixed effects parameters. If conditional = TRUE, the joint likelihood of the data conditional on the estimated random effects is used with an estimated effective degress of freedom that is calculated using the approach descsribed by Zhang et al. 2024 and code provided by Noel Cadigan.

Value

A numeric AIC value with attributes denoting the degrees of freedom, number of observations, and the type (marginal or conditional).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
mod <- fit_wham(input)
aic(mod)
aic(mod, conditional = TRUE)
} # }
